v2.5.2 (2026-10-06)

No download available for this version.

  • release Handle optional release repo updates

    Add optional RELEASE_REPO_PAT handling to android-release workflow so VERSION_OVERVIEW.md can be updated and pushed in a separate release repository. Generalize the version-overview helper to accept a file path and repository name, create the file when missing, and bump WizardScoreboard to 2.5.2 (ApplicationVersion 10327).

  • Publish APKs and changelog to separate release repo

    Add a GitHub Actions step to create/update a release in hvkooten/wizard-scoreboard-release and upload APK artifacts and per-version changelog notes when RELEASE_REPO_PAT is provided. Authenticates gh with the provided token, prepares artifacts (artifacts/wizard-scoreboard-android-v${DISPLAY_VERSION}.apk and artifacts/wizard-scoreboard-android.apk), extracts the "## v${DISPLAY_VERSION}" section from ChangeLog.md/CHANGELOG.md into a temp file, and uses gh release upload/create/edit (with --clobber and --verify-tag) to attach files and notes. This runs in addition to existing release steps targeting the current repo. Bump ApplicationVersion 10325 → 10326 (ApplicationDisplayVersion unchanged).

  • Clarify Scores/Points x10 setting

    Updated localized rules pages to explain that the “Scores/Points x10” option can be turned on or off, and that when it is off the tablet shows experience points divided by ten. Bumped ApplicationVersion from 10323 to 10325.

v2.5.1 (2026-10-05)

No download available for this version.

  • Combine same-name highscores; warn on deletes

    Update help pages and delete-group warnings in EN/DE/ES/FR/NL/DA to explain that same-named players across groups share highscore totals, deleting a group removes its scores, and unique names are recommended; bump ApplicationVersion to 10323.

  • Preserve group selection on navigation

    Re-select the active group before leaving group dialogs so OnAppearing does not reset the selection, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10321.

  • Add SelectGroup strings and bump build version

    Added the new SelectGroup localized string across English, Danish, German, Spanish, French, and Dutch resources, and incremented ApplicationVersion from 10319 to 10320.

  • Fix group edits and pending game startup

    Track unsaved group changes, preserve the bid-total rule caption and Windows picker behavior, keep generated group names stable after reordering, and add a Windows fallback for starting pending games after navigation; move startup logic in ScoreBoardPage and bump the app version.

  • Improve picker taps and preserve page state

    Add a shared OpensPickerOnTap helper to make labels and preview rows open pickers more reliably across Groups, Settings, and other pages. Preserve the selected group when switching in ScoreBoardPage, keep users on Settings after changing language, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10313.

  • Preserve selected group on new game start

    Keep the previously selected group when starting a new game from the groups page by skipping the session-group reset during StartGameOnAppearing. Bump ApplicationVersion to 10309.

v2.4.0 (2026-10-05)

No download available for this version.

  • Add quick rules and score scaling support

    Add QuickRulesPage with localized rule summaries and reusable rule files, introduce ScoreTimesTen and formatted score display helpers, update score-related UI, expand tests, and increment the app version.

  • Add Danish localization support

    Add da-DK resources, rules content, localization coverage, language selection, and supported cultures; bump application version to 10305.

v2.3.0 (2026-10-05)

No download available for this version.

  • Bump app version to 2.3.0

    Update ApplicationDisplayVersion and ApplicationVersion in WizardScoreboard.csproj, and sync Android and iOS version names to 2.3.0.

  • Rename trump setting and tighten no-trump rules

    Replace AllowNoTrump with DealerPicksTrump across models, UI, persistence, and tests; keep legacy JSON compatibility, update no-trump validation/trump selection behavior, revise localized rules text, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10302.

  • Render suit symbols as text

    Update localized rules pages to render heart and diamond suits with the text-style selector, and bump ApplicationVersion from 10298 to 10299.

  • Reorder character-card bullets

    Reorder the Wizard rules character-card bullet lists so color-based entries precede suit-based entries in DE, EN, ES, FR, and NL, and normalize HTML list indentation/formatting.

  • Refine Wizard rules translations and version

    Add separate color- and suit-based card order explanations with localized Wizard/Fool rankings in DE/EN/ES/FR/NL, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10297.

  • Support palette-aware rules rendering

    Update RulesPage to use ITrumpPaletteService, cache the active palette mode, and reload only when language, theme, or palette changes. Split localized rules HTML into suit-colors and suit-cards variants, add palette-specific CSS injection, bump ApplicationVersion to 10295, and add unit tests for ApplySuitStyle.

  • Clarify rules pages and bump version

    Updated rule pages in German, English, Spanish, French, and Dutch to clarify tablet setup, player ordering, trump selection, bidding flow, the bid-not-total rule, last-round correction, and pause/end/highscore options; incremented ApplicationVersion from 10290 to 10293.

  • Force no-trump on final round

    Add forced no-trump handling for the last round when the dealer does not choose trump, validate it in ScoreService, hide other trump options in the UI, add a unit test, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10290.

  • Bump version and unify Android signing

    Increment the application version and add conditional Android signing so Debug and Release can share the same keystore when credentials are set, avoiding signature mismatches and preserving app data. Update the discussion log with current status and verification guidance.

  • Recover crash logs in startup bug reports

    Add crash-log recovery on next app start, centralize platform storage in CrashLogStore, update Android/iOS persistence, append crash details to bug reports, add localized prompt strings, cover CrashLogStore with tests, and bump app version to 10288.

  • Fix iOS versioning and title layout

    Add iOS build number display, header label handling, title inset adjustments, crash diagnostics, and bump the app version.

  • Constrain HighscorePage scrolling layout

    Switch HighscorePage from StackLayout to Grid so the CollectionView height is constrained and can scroll properly; bump app build version to 10284.

  • Make text actions responsive

    Switch ScoreBoardPage text actions to a responsive Grid layout and add ApplyTextActionLayout() to manage row/column placement and row collapse. Bump ApplicationVersion to 10283.

  • Hide keyboard on player count change

    Hide the Android soft keyboard and clear focus before rebuilding GroupsPage entries, update player count resource strings to use “After…” wording, adjust keyboard spacer formatting, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10282.

  • Localize group labels and update GroupsPage

    Add translations for the new bid-not-total round-rule label and group name label, update GroupsPage to show the group name and a platform-specific round-rule header, reduce the Android keyboard spacer height adjustment, include the Copilot instructions file in the solution, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10280.

  • Improve Android keyboard scrolling

    Add a hidden keyboard spacer to GroupsPage so Android player name fields remain visible while typing, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10278.

  • Localize highscore headers and improve layout

    Added localized highscore column headers and tests for Localization.GetString() across en-US, nl-NL, de-DE, es-ES, and fr-FR. Updated HighscorePage to use localized labels, added resource entries for all supported languages, set Android soft input mode to Resize to keep lower fields visible, increased button heights for better touch usability, and bumped ApplicationVersion to 10277.

v2.2.0 (2026-10-01)

No download available for this version.

  • Default Trump palette to FourColors

    Default TrumpPaletteService to FourColors when no stored preference exists or the stored value is invalid; update tests and bump app versions to 2.2.0 (ApplicationVersion 10275).

  • Default no-trump start from Groups page

    Set Group.AllowNoTrump to true by default, update the localized ΓÇ£Dealer picks trumpΓÇ¥ caption across supported languages, add localization tests, and update GroupsPage/ScoreBoardPage so a selected saved group can be started directly from Groups when no game is active. Bumped ApplicationVersion to 10272.

  • Load localized rules in WebView

    Replace the Rules page static text with a WebView that loads localized HTML from app assets, add rules pages for en/de/es/fr/nl with responsive styling and English fallback, remove obsolete resource entries, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10268.

  • Support optional No Trump sessions

    Add group/session setting persistence, UI support, round validation, localized strings, and tests for No Trump; bump ApplicationVersion to 10267.

  • Pin bidding and actuals actions in footer

    Move bidding and actuals dialog buttons into a dedicated footer below the scrollable form, add shared footer/layout helpers, refine bid total warning logic, preserve round watermark/backdrop behavior, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10266.

  • Refresh scoreboard action button states

    Update ScoreBoardPage to apply paused/active action-button state before enabling controls, and bump the app build version to 10264.

  • Rework scoreboard action bar rendering

    Rebuild the scoreboard action bar with a dynamic ContentView layout, centralize button creation, refresh toolbar controls when simplified-button mode changes, sync localized captions, add Android regression verification notes, and bump the application version.

  • Add simplified buttons setting and tests

    Add Simplified buttons setting with persistence/localization, compact secondary actions in ScoreBoardPage, updated beta welcome wording, and tests; bump application version to 10261.

  • Add beta welcome flow and persistent setting

    Add beta welcome page, settings toggle, localization, and tests; preserve beta welcome state across startup and theme rebuilds; increment application version.

  • Add localized bug report actions

    Add localized bug-report support with versioned subjects, English technical details, and copy/open-email actions with clipboard fallback. Update resource strings for EN/NL/DE/ES/FR, expand localization tests, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10258.

  • Add localized bug reporting flow

    Add localized bug reporting, mobile and WinUI entry points, localization tests, and bump the application version.

  • Harden round validation and persistence

    Reject invalid/incomplete rounds, block new rounds until prior ones are finished, strip unfinished rounds from pause/resume/end/load paths, persist completed snapshots only, cancel abandoned round dialogs, expand validation/persistence tests, update localization, and bump app version to 10255.

  • Refactor settings and expand persistence tests

    Centralize user settings behind a preference-backed wrapper, inject preferences into core services, update screen wake handling, and add broader regression coverage for persistence, localization, score calculation, and group management.

  • Support last-round edits and restore history

    Added last-round correction support in ScoreService, RoundEntry snapshot restoration, scoreboard edit flow with visible bids and cancel/back support, page-appearance session restoration, localization updates, broader tests, and bumped ApplicationVersion to 10253.

  • Reuse scoreboard cells on refresh

    Rework ScoreBoardPage to update existing grid cells in place instead of rebuilding the full UI each refresh. Add a scoreboardCells map and shared UpdateCell helper for consistent header, score, and footer updates. Rebuild grid structure only when needed, use fixed round row indices, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10250.

  • Add iOS support and bump app version

    Add net10.0-ios support, iOS app bootstrap files, and Info.plist configuration; update Android app metadata; increment ApplicationVersion to 10249 and set app version to 2.1.0.

v2.1.0 (2026-10-01)

No download available for this version.

  • Tighten AppShell flyout on phones

    Reduce AppShell flyout width on phones, remove the extra Android toolbar inset after the hamburger icon, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10247.

  • Refine Android page title layout

    Adjusted the Android page title spacing to sit closer to the hamburger icon without clipping, reduced the title grid width offset from 88 to 68, and incremented ApplicationVersion to 10246.

  • Update splash screen and bump version

    Bump ApplicationVersion to 10245 and set the MAUI splash screen background color to #10161d while preserving the existing image and base size.

  • Refine group switching and duplicate checks

    Use a combined group name row with an action-sheet-driven group selector, validate against duplicate group names before saving, add localized duplicate-name strings, and bump the application version to 10244.

  • Persist language and first-run defaults

    Save the selected app language in AppSettings, restore it on startup, apply first-launch bold text defaults, switch the localization fallback to en-US, and bump ApplicationVersion.

  • Add branded splash and first-launch settings

    Introduce a custom startup splash with version, copyright, and localized disclaimer; route first launches to Settings; add shell page selection support; localize new strings; improve language labels; update app version and include splash asset.

  • Restore scoreboard UI after round popup

    Disable game buttons before showing the round popup, refresh the UI in a finally block to ensure recovery after failures or interruptions, shorten the comment, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10234.

  • Disable game buttons during start/pause

    Wrap game start and pause toggling in a shared helper that disables all action buttons, including Next Round, and yields so the disabled state is visible before slower work continues. Refresh the UI from the outer start wrapper even on early exit or exceptions, remove the duplicate refresh from StartGameCoreAsync, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10233.

  • Stabilize pause toggle UI

    Disabled Start/Pause/End briefly during TogglePauseAsync() to prevent repeated clicks while the scoreboard rebuilds, restored UI state on exceptions with RefreshUI(), and bumped ApplicationVersion to 10231.

  • Refine trump visuals and watermark

    Update CardSuits watermark to show round plus trump symbol, refine trump color palettes and selection styling, and bump application version to 10230.

  • Add default bid-total round label translations

    Add DefaultBidTotalRuleStartRound translations across EN/DE/ES/FR/NL and bump ApplicationVersion to 10229.

  • Split group actions and improve navigation

    Add edit-group flow from player selection, route create/edit actions to GroupsPage, auto-select new group when creating, refactor player selection results, add localized group labels, and bump application version.

  • Add localized Groups label

    Add localized "Groups" string for English, German, Spanish, French, and Dutch resources, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10226.

  • Reuse modal for bidding/actuals flow

    Rework DisplayRoundPopupAsync to reuse the same modal when switching from bidding to actuals, add bid validation text colors, keep the popup open across the flow, improve cancel/error modal closing, add a guarded Back control for actuals, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10225.

  • Generalize bid rules and restore sessions

    Dynamic round-limit helpers now drive bid-total rules across Settings, Groups, and Scoreboard; button styling and dark-mode dialog visuals were refined; actuals refresh and player name rendering were improved; active saved sessions now resume paused and all active sessions persist; app version updated to 10220.

  • Add theme persistence and dark mode support

    Persist app theme, add a settings picker, rebuild AppShell on theme changes, centralize theme-aware colors, update UI to use shared dark-mode resources, fix header bolding, add localized strings, and bump the application version.

  • Move HeaderLabel bolding to Android handler

    Extract Android bold enforcement for HeaderLabel into a dedicated handler, register it conditionally on Android, update related comments, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10206.

  • Refine AboutPage version display

    Show Android version text with build number and use version-only text on other platforms via a local variable for cleaner platform-specific assignment.

  • Restore bold Shell headers on Android

    Reapply bold styling for HeaderLabel on Android during font/text updates, keep Shell headers bold again, show app version and build on About page, and bump ApplicationVersion to 10204.

v1.0.0 (2026-06-15)

No download available for this version.

  • feat: Update README with app details, add Android release workflow, and create version overview
  • feat: Add CI workflow configuration and update README with project description
  • test: Refactor ScoreServiceTests to remove GroupService dependency and add new test cases for bid total rule logic
  • feat: Enhance SettingsPage with trump palette preview and align bid total rule with player count
  • feat: Implement bid total rule start round setting and update related logic across multiple components
  • feat: Update game end logic with confirmation dialog and enhance celebration display for winners
  • feat: Enhance ScoreBoardPage layout with header and footer grids, and improve scrolling behavior
  • feat: Add bid total rule start round setting and update logic in ScoreService
  • feat: Implement player selection and bid total rule start round feature

    - Added functionality to save and restore window size preferences in App.cs. - Introduced player selection logic in ScoreBoardPage.cs, allowing users to select players for a game. - Updated ScoreSession model to include BidTotalRuleStartRound property to manage the starting round for the bid total rule. - Enhanced SettingsPage.cs to allow configuration of the starting round for the bid total rule. - Modified IScoreService and ScoreService to support starting a game with a selected list of players. - Added localization strings for new features in multiple languages.

  • Add localization support for French and Dutch languages, enhance group management, and implement trump palette service

    - Updated resource files for French (Strings.fr.resx) and Dutch (Strings.nl.resx) with new game-related strings. - Enhanced GroupService to manage selected groups and persist group data using Preferences. - Added ITrumpPaletteService and TrumpPaletteService to manage trump palette modes and labels. - Adjusted scoring logic in ScoreService to reflect correct scoring rules. - Updated project file for .NET MAUI compatibility and added necessary Android and Windows platform files. - Introduced app icons and splash screen resources for better branding. - Added .gitignore to exclude build artifacts and user-specific files.
